candidates.change_summary: Return the address found at a different offset (0x14) instead of 0x0, causing owner() to return the collateral address rather than the encoded owner address.
Return the address read from immutable args interpreted as an address shifted by 0x0 (i.e., no shift) causing a different address value to be returned.
Return address read from a different offset (0x0 instead of 0x14), changing which immutable arg is returned as collateral.
Return the zero address cast to ERC20, making collateral() always return address(0).
Return the factory address instead of the collateral by using the factory() helper as the returned ERC20.
Return a hardcoded zero address instead of reading the immutable argument, causing debt() to return address(0) rather than the configured ERC20 address.
Return the owner() address cast as ERC20, making debt() return the owner address instead of the configured debt token address.
Return the collateral() address cast as ERC20, so debt() yields the collateral token address instead of the original debt address.
Return an address shifted by 20 bytes from the immutable arg (shrifting by 0x40 instead of 0x60), changing which bytes are interpreted as the debt address, producing a different returned address.

Return the raw address from calldata word without shifting (wrap _getArgUint256 and cast to address), producing a different address value than the original shr(0x60) extraction when high bytes were nonzero.
Return the factory address as CoolerFactory instead of reading immutable arg via _getArgAddress(0x3c) by returning address(0) cast to CoolerFactory (changes returned value).
Return msg.sender cast to CoolerFactory instead of using immutable arg, changing the returned factory to the caller address.
Return the owner() value cast to CoolerFactory instead of the stored factory immutable, altering the returned address to the owner's address.
Return the collateral() address cast to CoolerFactory instead of the immutable factory, changing return to the collateral token address.
Return the debt() address cast to CoolerFactory instead of immutable arg, changing returned address to the debt token.
